system.description:
By forcing your chakra into one shot of your ammunition, you can cause it to splinter into multiple shots. Choose up to three creatures you can see in range. Make a single ranged taijutsu attack comparing the result to all select creatures AC. On a hit, you deal your [Weapons damage] +2d6 and each affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw, gaining a rank of Bleeding on a failed save.

Chain 1: This attack gains a +1 bonus to its critical threat range if the target has temporary hit points, and a +2 bonus if they have a Jutsu based bonus to AC.

Chain 2: A creature who failed their saving throw gains an additional rank of Bleeding.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-rank increase the cost by 3 and the damage by 1d4 and max by 1d4.
